CustomField.description: Load-bearing. The managed frops_flow__ProcessGiftCommitment aborts with "org wide default designation is not yet configured" if no active GD has IsDefault=true. FQS seed flags FQS-GD-GENERAL-OPERATING on install. Only one GD may be IsDefault=true at a time; the platform enforces uniqueness across active records. To retire the current default, promote a successor first.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check exactly ONE active designation as the org-wide default — usually the general operating fund. Gifts that arrive without an explicit designation split fall through to this bucket.
